evidence.quote: From among the range of topics in which financial sector reforms have been instituted since 2008, I focus on three: capital and liquidity for banks and other financial institutions, macroprudential supervision, and the problem of too big to fail (TBTF).
The United States is making significant progress in strengthening the financial system and reducing the probability of future financial crises.
From the viewpoint of the stability of the financial system, more of each is better.
